summary: Ignore difficult terrain and resist forced movement. Use Infernal Evasion to salvage a failed save, or Hellcrawler to teleport.

fields.Steadfast: Prevents Prone-group effects and hostile or allied forced movement. Ignores most difficult terrain, but Deep Water still applies.
fields.Infernal Evasion: Spend a Reaction to salvage a failed save. It recharges after any rest despite the Long Rest tooltip. The source reports prompts on successful saves and that spells with both an attack and a save can give the +99 bonus to the attacker’s attack roll instead.
fields.Hellcrawler: Bonus Action once per Short Rest. Teleport up to 60 ft. Creatures in a 10 ft radius take 2d8 Fire, or a reported 1d8 on a successful DC 15 Dexterity save. Leaves a 7 ft Fire surface for 2 turns that immediately deals 1d4 Fire to the wearer unless immune to Burning.
fields.Base value: 450 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
